description: This file defines the HubService class, which manages user sessions, authentication, and settings synchronization with a Hub backend in a financial application. It includes methods for connecting, disconnecting, pushing, and pulling user settings, as well as handling token validation and conversion between platform and hub models.

classes.name: HubService
classes.description: A class that manages user sessions, authentication, and settings synchronization with a Hub backend, including token validation and model conversions.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a session with the Hub using email/password or platform token.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current session with the Hub.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes user settings to the Hub.

methods.name: pull
methods.description: Retrieves user settings from the Hub.

methods.name: _get_session_from_email_password
methods.description: Creates a HubSession object by authenticating with email and password.

methods.name: _get_session_from_platform_token
methods.description: Creates a HubSession object using a platform personal access token.

methods.name: _post_logout
methods.description: Logs out the current session from the Hub.

methods.name: _get_user_settings
methods.description: Fetches user settings from the Hub.

methods.name: _put_user_settings
methods.description: Updates user settings on the Hub.

methods.name: hub2platform
methods.description: Converts Hub user settings to platform credentials and defaults.

methods.name: platform2hub
methods.description: Converts platform credentials and defaults to Hub user settings.

methods.name: _check_token_expiration
methods.description: Verifies if a platform token has expired.
